text:
Raj Patel: FYI — got flagged by hiring manager. Yesterday's interviewer reminder batch accidentally CC'd the candidate email on ~12 messages. Looks like a template mishap during the ATS migration where {{interviewer_email}} and {{candidate_email}} got swapped.

Maya Chen: Oh no. Any PII exposure? Were scorecards attached?

Raj Patel: Candidate emails were in CC only, no attachments. Scorecard links were included too, which is worse: an interviewer link and candidate link differ. Need to assess whether any candidate clicked an interviewer scoring form.

Priya Singh: This is a privacy incident if a candidate saw the interviewer link. We should triage under our data incident playbook.

Elena Gomez: Also heard from two new interviewers confused about the updated scorecard UI. They said the new rubric labels (1-5) were moved and they couldn't find the 'Documentation' checkbox. Might be a training gap from the migration.

Lin Zhao: Timeline from Integrations: template change deployed at 22:14 UTC, reminder batch run at 22:20 UTC. Looks like a stale variable mapping in the mail-merge step.

integrations-bot: Template source: ATS Admin -> Templates -> Interviewer Reminder. Current body: "Hi {{interviewer_name}}, you have an interview at {{interview_time}}. Candidate: {{candidate_email}}. Please submit: {{interviewer_link}}". Post-migration available vars: {{interviewer_email}}, {{candidate_email}}, {{interviewer_url}}, {{profile_url}}. Mapping error: developer used {{interviewer_link}} which resolved to candidate-facing URL in new schema.

ats-admin-bot: Quick containment options: (A) retract the offending batch by sending a follow-up recall email to recipients; (B) send an apology + correction to interviewers and candidates; (C) rotate any short-lived tokens in the links. Recommend B + token rotation.

Priya Singh: Agreed on B + rotation. Also need an incident record. I've opened HR-SEC-2026-77 and added preliminary severity = medium. Please add affected count and actions.

Maya Chen: Integrations, can you produce a list of the 12 messages, recipients, and exact link variants so we can determine if any candidate clicked a scoring link?

integrations-bot: Exporting batch log... done. Affected reminders: 12. Interviewer recipients: 12 internal emails. Candidate CCs: 12 candidate emails obfuscated. Click logs: 3 clicks from candidate IPs on the link type that corresponds to interviewer UI. Token usage: 0 form submissions recorded but 3 GETs to the interviewer scoring endpoint.

Raj Patel: Ok that's better than forms filled. Still needs comms. Priya can you draft candidate-safe copy? We should be transparent without causing alarm.

Priya Singh: Draft for candidates: "We recently sent you an email in error that included internal scheduling info. No personal data beyond your email address was exposed and no action is required. If you have concerns, reply to hr@redwood.com." Thoughts?

Elena Gomez: For interviewers: short apology + correct link and a brief note about the new scorecard layout with screenshot + link to quick training video (2min). We should offer to walk new interviewers through the rubric.

Maya Chen: Also immediate fixes: (1) revert the mail-merge to use explicit variables {{interviewer_url}} and {{profile_url}}, (2) rotate short-lived scoring tokens used in reminder links, (3) add a pre-send validation that checks recipient domains and removes candidate emails from CC.

integrations-bot: Patch queued: updating template body to use {{interviewer_url}} and removing candidate fields from CC block. Will apply with 2-min maintenance window.

ats-admin-bot: Token rotation scheduled for 01:05 UTC. Will invalidate old scoring links.

Lin Zhao: Elena, can you produce the quick walkthrough and point people to it from the apology email? We should get that out in the next hour.

Elena Gomez: On it. I'll upload a 2-min Loom and include two screenshots showing where "Documentation" checkbox is and how to rate on the new 1-5 scale.

Raj Patel: I'll consolidate messaging. Proposed interviewer follow-up (short): "Hi — earlier reminder email contained incorrect CCs and a link mismatch. We've invalidated the old links and updated the reminder template. Please use this link to open the scorecard: https://ats.redwood.internal/profiles/{id}/scorecard. Quick walkthrough: <loom link>. If you need help, reply here and we'll schedule a 10-min drop-in"

Priya Singh: Sending candidate note now. Will BCC privacy@redwood.com.

integrations-bot: Template update applied. Pre-send validation added to staging.

nats-admin-bot: Incident HR-SEC-2026-77 updated: affected_count=12, candidate_clicks=3, forms_submitted=0, mitigation=template_patch+token_rotation+comms.

Maya Chen: Follow-ups assigned: Integrations to monitor for 24h; Elena to publish training + link; People Ops to include template variable verification in migration checklist; Security to review click logs.

Priya Singh: Candidate email sent at 23:12 UTC. Interviewer patch note sent at 23:18 UTC with Loom link.

Raj Patel: All good. Closing loop: will run a weekly audit script to verify mail-merge mappings across templates. Thanks team. :heart:
